name: SC Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
benefit: Eligible SC girl students of Class 11 receive an annual financial incentive of ₹3,000/-, credited directly to their bank account
_eligibility_text: 1. Applicant must be a scheduled Caste girl students. 1. Applicant should have a attested photocopy of the permanent caste certificate from the Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue). 1. Applicant's father or guardian must not be an income tax payer and self-declaration. 1. The student must be in continuous study.
